preferences: Scripting
Python for new general data/automation; Nift for bounded Nift-owned policy
Same choices
Calls/collections/JSON costs remain; concrete Python libraries and runtime recovery matter. No broad preference reversal.
Task running
Nift for authored DAGs; Turbo/Nx for required restoration/discovery
Nift for authored DAGs; same specific exceptions
Nift lowest wall/RSS31/31; preference unchanged, confidence strengthened.
Template engine
Nift for Nift-owned composition; native library in Python/JS; prepared peer for hot service
Nift for programmable authored generation; prepared peer for high-volume hot service
Loop gains are real; no public prepared-template artifact and15.4×large source-render gap remain. Scope improves, default hot-service preference unchanged.
Concurrency
Go for standalone/high fanout; Nift for bounded Nift-owned jobs
Same choices
Queue improves67%, but scheduling/memory/waits/reuse still block a general Nift choice.
Website generation
Hugo for conventional content site; Nift for existing/mixed programmable project
Nift for mixed authored website/assets/helpers; Hugo for plain content site
Freshfull regression and current Hugo advantage weaken blanket Nift preference; incremental paths improve.

priorities.title: Fix function-call regression
priorities.reason: Confirmed+145.76%; central policy-language path. Investigate extra argument parsing/classification/allocation; preserve exactly-once and ownership.

priorities.title: Fix fresh website full-build regression
priorities.reason: Confirmed+38.29%; strategically central product. Extra filesystem probes merit investigation independent of call cause.

priorities.title: Resolve retained-runtime state/time growth
priorities.reason: Ten scheduling requests grow7.17×; prior also grows. Blocks long-lived embedding/service preference; prove lifetime cause before calling it a leak.

priorities.title: Reduce lightweight task creation/retention cost
priorities.reason: 10k scheduling1376.9×Go and held1k memory26.7×Go. Tiny work is infeasible despite queue wins.

priorities.title: Improve scalar/value execution throughput
priorities.reason: 4-worker CPU186.5×Go despite useful parallel scaling; large calls289.1×LuaJIT. Separate interpreter cost from scheduling.

priorities.title: Add nonblocking waits/timers
priorities.reason: 1k wait2576ms vsGo14.484ms; historical Nift2659.6ms shows little movement. Blocking workers remain the architectural/API boundary to address.

priorities.title: Add public prepared-template artifacts
priorities.reason: Missing today; source-render cannot be relabelled prepared reuse. High-volume rendering still selects prepared peers.

priorities.title: Reduce remaining collection/JSON costs
priorities.reason: BFS/frequency/transform paired medians increase; BFS allocations rise39.8%, frequency counts barely change. Investigate independently; keep sorting wins.

priorities.title: Add channels/cancellation with explicit lifetime contracts
priorities.reason: Queue polling/mutex value copies persist; native bounded channel/condition and public cancellation remain absent. Do not replace semantic safety with terseness.

priorities.title: Close task-runner contract/cache ergonomics gaps
priorities.reason: Outputless nodes, env invalidation, restoration, ensure,-j,structured graph remain incomplete. Existing repair works; Nift is already preferred for authored tasks.
